verdict.rationale: Both changes make the same correct conversion. They drop `* 1000` in cache, retry and scheduler, convert back to seconds in http and report, and recompute the validate limits in milliseconds; both add the same kinds of tests. B also builds the validate error messages from the limit strings, which ties messages to limits but is a small extra edit. A keeps the edit minimal and puts the new tests in one file per module, which is slightly cleaner than B's combined `report_http.test.ts`. Neither difference is big enough to prefer one PR.
a_issues: The `5s`/`1d` text in the validate error messages is still hardcoded separately from `MIN_TTL_MS`/`MAX_TTL_MS`, so the two can drift apart.
The below-minimum test only matches `/below the minimum/`, not the actual limit value.
b_issues: Moving the validate error messages to template strings is a small refactor beyond what the task needs.
Putting the http and report tests in one file, `test/report_http.test.ts`, is less tidy than one test file per module.

B's report also says the new tests passed against the original code before the change, which shows they guard existing behavior.
